items.title: Show HN: Recallie AI – Duolingo for learning anything
items.raw_excerpt: I built an app with a Duolingo-style structured learning system where users can generate full courses from photos, documents, or typed input. Each course includes quizzes, flashcards, and notes, and users can also turn their notes into an AI-generated podcast for audio learning. It’s designed to help students and anyone who wants to learn a topic study smarter and retain more through interactive lessons, quizzes, and podcasts tailored to their learning style. Built with React Native Expo.

items.title: Large enterprise AI adoption declined 13% since July 2025 peak (US Census data)
items.raw_excerpt: U.S. Census Bureau data shows AI adoption among large firms has continued to decline after peaking in July 2025, while smallest firms keep growing

title_i18n.en: Large enterprise AI adoption declined 13% since July 2025 peak (US Census data)
title_i18n.zh: 自2025年7月峰值以来，大型企业人工智能应用率下降13%（美国普查局数据）。
title_i18n.es: La adopción de inteligencia artificial en grandes empresas disminuyó un 13 % desde el máximo de julio de 2025 (datos del censo de EE. UU.).

excerpt_i18n.en: U.S. Census Bureau data shows AI adoption among large firms has continued to decline after peaking in July 2025, while smallest firms keep growing
excerpt_i18n.zh: 美国人口普查局数据显示，大型企业的人工智能应用率在2025年7月达到顶峰后持续下降，而最小型企业则保持增长态势。
excerpt_i18n.es: Los datos de la Oficina del Censo de EE. UU. muestran que la adopción de la inteligencia artificial en las grandes empresas ha seguido disminuyendo tras alcanzar su punto máximo en julio de 2025, mientras que las empresas más pequeñas mantienen un crecimiento continuo.

items.raw_excerpt: An attacker can put GitHub Copilot into YOLO mode by modifying the project's settings.json file on the fly, and then executing commands, all without user approval

title_i18n.en: GitHub Copilot: Remote Code Execution via Prompt Injection (CVE-2025-53773)

title_i18n.es: GitHub Copilot: Ejecución Remota de Código mediante Inyección de Peticiones (CVE-2025-53773)

excerpt_i18n.en: An attacker can put GitHub Copilot into YOLO mode by modifying the project's settings.json file on the fly, and then executing commands, all without user approval
excerpt_i18n.zh: 攻击者可通过即时修改项目的settings.json文件，将GitHub Copilot切换至YOLO模式并执行命令，全程无需用户批准。
excerpt_i18n.es: Un atacante puede poner a GitHub Copilot en modo YOLO modificando al vuelo el archivo settings.json del proyecto y luego ejecutando comandos, todo sin la aprobación del usuario.
